<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Test if A and B will obviously have the same value.</p>


<p>This includes recognizing that t0 and t1 will have the same value in code like this:</p>


<div class="doxyProgramListing">

<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight">%t0 = getelementptr \@a, 0, 3</span></span></div>

<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight">%t1 = getelementptr \@a, 0, 3</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight">%t2 = load i32* %t1</span></span></div>

</div>
